meta.xpStance: XP award rules remain BLOCKED (thresholds exist; CR→XP / encounter XP budgets are not canon). This toolkit uses bible EV / incoming-pressure bands and the eight-actor rule only. Milestone / narrative advancement assumed. Do not invent a second XP economy.

tierFloorMap.note: Last depth where stable small civilizations remain normal (bible Ch 31 / Ch 63).
Old God Interstice sits after Xarog / before Eirfax — not a Gate Guardian.

budgetGuidance.method: Combat as Expected Value (Director bible Ch 15)

formulas.hitAssumption: Assume ~2/3 of foe attacks/saves land unless accuracy or defenses say otherwise (Ch 29)

pressureBands.directorReading: Use only if it teaches, reveals, or spends a meaningful non-HP resource
Win with visible cost if engaged honestly
Poor opening / failed objective can drop characters; retreat must remain possible
Telegraph clearly; terrain, prep, or objective leverage required
Only if party knowingly chose risk, has exits, or fight is not meant to be won by damage alone

budgetGuidance.rolePressure: Add one pressure step if two or more apply without a known counter: reliable stun/paralysis, forced movement into severe hazards, flight vs melee-heavy party, invisibility without detection, meaningful foe healing, protected independent objective. Remove one step for surprise, strong chokepoint, researched vulnerability, or participating allies.

eightActorRule.waves: Prepare total opposition; reveal only perceptible actors first. Later waves need a visible trigger. Never add waves solely because the first group died quickly.

budgetGuidance.expeditionSeatNote: Full Expedition max 12 (RAW). Detailed combat usually runs the Combat team (~4) plus a few allies/foes under the eight-actor cap; other seats resolve via clocks/checks.

suggestedDetailedActorCountsByJob.Choosing: 2–5 foes or split fronts via off-map objective
suggestedDetailedActorCountsByJob.ClimacticSeal: Guardian + 0–2 arena features as detailed actors; extra pressure via plates/phases/waves under eight-actor
suggestedDetailedActorCountsByJob.Interstice: Prefer identity/memory/route pressure over raw damage; ≤8 detailed if any combat forms

tierThreatNotes.notes: Route / witness / anchor politics are primary tax. Civilization rivalry can substitute for HP fights. Seal = Hard→Severe with path-choice Recognition.
Every fight carries a term. Winning combat while losing the stated claim is valid. Seal leaves ≥1 binding term for Tier 8. Interstice after Gate is not XP.
Delayed identity / reflection leverage. Settlements are exceptional. Seal tests which version of the Expedition deserves continuity.
False progress + compression. Circular strategies strengthen Threxus. Use transformation anchors, not distance marks.
Anti-resonance + stillness offer. Marquis may be defeated, replaced, persuaded, bound, or transformed — not a pure HP wall. Silent Ones: never name aloud.

bestiaryCaveat: Trash/zone fauna in bestiary_data_full.json often has sandbox Type/CR/zoneFound mismatches. Rosters prefer lore-scrubbed names that exist post BESTIARY_LORE_PASS and state intendedCrBand for EV planning. When excel CR is absurd, use bible Ch 17 reskin from a same-band template. Never use SWTOR names. Prefer Umbrin over any residual Drow labels. Do not rewrite bestiary combat stats from this toolkit.
